fato_historico: 2007: A raid on Anuradhapura Air Force Base is carried out by 21 Tamil Tiger commandos, with all except one dying in this attack. Eight Sri Lanka Air Force planes are destroyed and ten damaged.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may find that the scales of your life seek profound equilibrium. Much like a quiet garden recovering after a fierce, turbulent storm, your spirit is ready to rebuild and find peace. Consider letting go of past conflicts and focus on nurturing your inner sanctuary. It is a good time to choose grace over unnecessary struggle.
frase_do_dia: Even after the strongest winds, the most beautiful flowers will always bloom again.
significado_numero: Represents the path of transformation and the completion of personal cycles.
conselho: Focus on restoration and seek beauty in every small act today.
